name: Student Loan Interest Deduction Calculator
meta_description: See how much student loan interest you can deduct in 2026, up to $2,500 with the income phase-out, and how much federal and state tax it saves.
subtitle: Work out your 2026 student loan interest deduction after the income phase-out, the tax it saves and what your loan rate works out to after that saving.

card.fields_html:
Enter your interest and income

2026 federal tax rules

$

Shown on Form 1098-E from your loan servicer. Up to $2,500 can be deducted.

$

Wages and other income before this deduction. For most people this is the adjusted gross income on Form 1040 without the student loan interest deduction.

More options

Child tax credits can reduce your tax to zero, which limits the saving.

%

Most states with an income tax start from federal AGI, so the deduction also lowers state tax. Use 0 to leave state tax out.

%

Used to show your loan rate after the tax saving.
